value.title: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Freedom
value.synopsis: During cosmic era 75, the Coordinators, genetically enhanced human beings, and the Naturals, naturally born humans who have not undergone the genetic enhancement process, face each other in battles to the death for the survival of their own kind. “A drawn destiny or the freedom to resist…”.
